page: Microsoft Azure D8lds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Dldsv6 family, powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor. It features 8 vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a low memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Storage is bundled, consisting of a 472 GB local NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPU accelerators are present.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-threaded capabilities. The server achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 2166.0 and a single-threaded gzip compression throughput of 31.52 GB/sec, both falling into the strong tier. Multi-core performance is moderate, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 7990.55 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 8360.0. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 621.35 GB/sec, while large-block uncached read and write speeds reach 67.27 GB/sec and 45.65 GB/sec respectively. For specialized workloads, the CPU's Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512 support assist in tasks like small-model LLM inference, where it achieves 313.4 tokens/sec for text generation on a 135M model, though performance drops to 7.97 tokens/sec on a larger 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D8lds_v6 offers a resource-dense compute profile by pairing high-frequency dedicated Intel silicon with a reduced memory footprint. This makes it a cost-effective choice for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive RAM allocations. The inclusion of a fast 472 GB local NVMe SSD adds high-speed local scratch space without requiring external storage attachments. This server is best suited for compute-optimized tasks, single-threaded applications, text processing, web serving, and lightweight database operations.
description: Microsoft Azure D8lds_v6 is an x86_64 compute-optimized server from the Dldsv6 family, featuring 8 vCPUs and 4 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz. It is configured with a low-memory profile of 16.0 GB RAM and includes a 472 GB local NVMe SSD. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel AMX. Benchmark results show strong single-core performance, highlighted by a Geekbench single-core score of 2166.0 and a single-threaded gzip compression speed of 31.52 GB/sec. Multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics remain in the average tier. Lacking a GPU, this server is qualitatively cost-efficient for compute-heavy, memory-light workloads. It is highly suitable for web serving, text processing, software compilation, and applications requiring fast local scratch storage.
